source: Armor exotics and talent text from the Division Fandom page Exotic Items in The Division 2, plus Iron Will, Provocator, and Fafnir from the Red Horizon page and Centurion's Scabbard from Title Update 22. Exotic weapon talent text was not on that page, so those talentText fields stay null. Birdie's Quick Fix Pack is listed with no talent because the page marks it WIP.

items.name: Vile
items.talentText: Status effects also apply a damage over time debuff for 10s. Total damage dealt is equal to 50% of your concussion grenade damage and increased by your status effect attributes.

items.name: Coyote's Mask
items.talentText: You and allies gain a bonus based on the distance of the last enemy you hit. 0-15m +25% critical hit damage, 15-25m +10% critical hit damage and +10% critical hit chance, beyond 25m +25% critical hit chance.

items.name: Catharsis
items.talentText: Taking damage builds stacks to a cap of 30. Each stack grants 1% Weapon Damage. Taking damage at max stacks purges stacks and status effects and drops a healing cloud that restores 5% of Max Armor for 10 seconds.

items.name: Ridgeway's Pride
items.talentText: Shooting enemies within 15m applies bleed. Repair 3-48% of your armor per second for every bleeding enemy within 15m.

items.name: Tardigrade Armor System
items.talentText: Whenever you or any ally's armor breaks, they gain 80% of your armor as bonus armor for 10s. Cooldown per ally: 45s. Killing an enemy with your specialization weapon removes this cooldown for all allies.

items.name: Collector
items.talentText: +3 Grenade Capacity, +50% Grenade Radius, +35% Grenade Damage, and +25% Grenade Damage for each extra enemy caught in the blast. Regenerates grenades every 30s if you have fewer than 2.

items.name: Iron Will
items.talentText: Your next body shot is considered a headshot. Cooldown 2s in PvE and 3s in PvP. Requires an MMR, rifle, or pistol.

items.name: Provocator
items.talentText: Receive +35% Damage Resistance from enemies within 15m.

items.name: Dodge City Gunslinger's Holster
items.talentText: While your pistol is holstered, gain a stacking buff every 0.5s up to 100. Swapping to it consumes the buff and the first shot deals +10% damage per stack as headshot damage.

items.name: Waveform
items.talentText: Generate a stack of 3% skill damage on one skill every second, capping at 10 stacks. After 10 seconds at the cap the stacks transfer to your other skill.

items.name: Imperial Dynasty
items.talentText: While in combat, applies burn to the closest enemy within 20m. Cooldown: 40s.

items.name: Shocker Punch
items.talentText: Shock stun is reduced by 50%. A shield gives 100% melee damage. With St. Elmo's Engine the next melee applies Shock. All three together make that Shock a 5m radius. Cooldown 15 seconds.

items.name: Centurion's Scabbard
items.talentText: Swapping weapons cycles rate of fire and weapon damage, then magazine size and reload speed. PvE bonuses last 12s. PvP bonuses last 10s. Swapping to the sidearm does not advance the cycle.

items.name: Nimble Holster
items.talentText: Cover-to-cover restores 5% repairs per meter in PvE or 3% in PvP. Damage taken during the move is healed over 10s.

items.name: Memento
items.talentText: Kills drop a trophy. Collecting it grants a 10s buff that scales with core attributes, and a long buff up to 30 stacks: +1% weapon damage, +1% skill efficiency, and +0.1% armor regeneration for 300s.

items.name: Acosta's Go-Bag
items.talentText: Throwing a grenade refunds it and grants +1 skill tier for 15s, or overcharge at skill tier 6. Cooldown 60s. Also raises armor kit, grenade, and ammo capacity plus repair skills and status effects.

items.name: NinjaBike Messenger Bag
items.talentText: Counts as one piece toward any equipped gear set or brand set bonus, including more than one set at the same time.

items.name: BTSU Datagloves
items.talentText: Grants +15% Hive skill haste per skill tier. Detonating a Hive refreshes allies' skill cooldowns and grants overcharge for 15s. Those allies cannot gain it again for 120s.

items.name: Bloody Knuckles
items.talentText: A grenade or melee activates Seeing Red: +25% weapon damage and +100% melee damage for 20s, then a 60s cooldown. Another grenade or melee during the cooldown ends it immediately.

items.name: Rugged Gauntlets
items.talentText: -50% recoil penalty while hip-firing and -50% recoil penalty while blind-firing from cover.

items.name: Sawyer's Kneepads
items.talentText: Cannot be staggered by explosions. Total weapon damage increases by 3% each second you are not moving, up to 10 stacks, lost 10s after you move.

items.name: NinjaBike Kneepads
items.talentText: A cover-to-cover or vault reloads your drawn weapon and grants +25% bonus armor for 5s.

items.name: Acosta's Kneepads
items.talentText: Vaulting, climbing, or dropping grants +10% movement speed for 3s. Standing still for 5s then grants +20% movement speed for 5s. Status effects grant +10% movement speed for 5s, and movement impairment from status effects is reduced by 50%.

items.name: Fafnir
items.talentText: This weapon fires Dragon's Breath shells. Each shot has a 40% chance of applying Burn. Weapon Damage is amplified by 50% of your Status Effect bonus.
